description: Frozen direct-boundary baseline for the WebUI internal dependency check, measured before any migration (plan section 7.5). Each entry is one violating file pair. `stage` is the migration stage after which the entry must be deleted; deleting it is enforced because a baseline entry that is no longer violated fails the check.

cycles.reason: Stream frame reduction and stream instrumentation reference each other. The reducer moved out of client/stream.ts to client/projection/stream-state.ts (plan §7.3) but the back edge remains until stage 4 separates the stream lease/loop mechanisms from the projection state.

allowances.reason: Node subprocess entry point loads its bundled embedded CLI through a URL object, not a statically resolvable specifier. It is a Node executable entry, not part of the browser or server module graph.
